messages:
maria: heads up — noticing a cluster of traces that only have the root span for payment-service. child spans (http/db) missing for many requests starting ~09:10 UTC. looks tenant-scoped to org-842.

amit: which path are those requests taking? ingress proxy + otlp exporter? any 4xx/5xx in exporter logs?

maria: yes, goes through edge-east-2 -> router -> payment-service. exporter is our OTLP/gRPC path. quick sample trace id: 0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c — only root span shows in UI.

sam_oncall: looking at ingest logs now. I see a spike at 09:11:10 where the exporter batcher reported backpressure and started dropping spans for a handful of tenants. log snippet: 
```
INGEST [09:11:10Z] level=warn tenant=org-842 exporter=otlp queue_len=10240 dropped_spans=238 reason=queue_overflow
```

ingest-bot: :warning: alert: otlp-ingest queue overflow (edge-east-2) — per-tenant drop rate exceeded threshold for org-842

lisa: interesting — could be quota throttle. but why are only child spans missing (root present)? sampling propagation issue or header rewrite?

amit: check proxy header rules. I recall a recent nginx tweak that normalizes headers. if traceparent/tracecontext gets renamed casing-wise some SDKs ignore parent context and treat requests as new traces. that plus per-tenant burst quota could make child spans appear as separate short traces or be dropped during batching.

maria: digging into the proxy config. found this rewrite in the `edge-east-2` vhost: `proxy_set_header TraceContext $http_tracecontext;` — we used to preserve `traceparent`/`tracestate` exactly.

amit: that will break a lot of SDKs. they look for `traceparent` lowercase or official header names. If the parent header is missing the service will start fresh root spans; exporter then sees many tiny traces and our per-tenant quotas/backpressure can drop children or aggregated spans.

sam_oncall: can we patch and hotfix? we still have a short buffer but drops are ongoing. mitigation options: temporarily raise per-tenant burst quota for org-842 and disable the header rewrite. also enable fallback sink to write to local disk for a few minutes.

maria: rolling a config change to remove the rewrite now (edge-east-2). rolling in canary -> if green push to rest. also increasing tenant burst quota for org-842 in the rate-limiter for 10m.

lisa: quick debug command if anyone needs it: 
```
curl -s "https://ingest-logs.internal/_search?tenant=org-842&level=warn&from=09:05&to=09:20" | jq '.hits[] | {msg: .message, ts: .ts}'
```

amit: after removing the header rewrite I can already see traces reassembling in the dev cluster. child spans return for sampled traces.

maria: can confirm in prod: trace 0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c now shows HTTP client and DB children. pushing full rollout.

sam_oncall: good. follow-ups: (1) add a unit/integration test for header passthrough in the edge proxy, (2) dashboard alert for per-tenant dropped_spans_ratio > 0.5% for 5m, (3) add automated temporary quota bump runbook.

lisa: created dashboard PR 856 with panels for per-tenant drop rate and queue_len, plus alert. added test case in proxy-integration suite.

maria: thanks all — resolved. will file a postmortem with timeline and action items later. :white_check_mark:
